summary: Stable releases publish only after the product release GO. The daily schedule and tag builds prepare draft candidates; a separate manual publish dispatch requires the exact candidate source SHA and a recorded GO reference.

compatibility.detail: No binary or wire changes; stable consumers continue to use published releases only.

downtime.detail: No runtime deployment occurs when creating a candidate.

manual.detail: After the product release owner records GO for the full candidate SHA, dispatch release-daily.yml on main with mode=publish, tag, sha and go_ref. Candidate creation alone no longer publishes or advances compatibility baselines. See docs/st3/binary-releases.md.

recovery.detail: A rejected publish leaves the candidate unpublished. Correct the SHA or GO reference and dispatch again; never move a candidate or published tag.
